2026-10-13 chairman's confirmation row, ONE ROW, fired after the day's cadenced batch returned and BEFORE the research analyst's return. IT DOES NOT RE-FIRE OR RE-ANCHOR THE CADENCED LIMB - thread 11's relay limb was discharged by analytics/fetch-requests/2026-10-13-daily.json (blob 508b7c2dd3666235c76f7e3ce6310664fe4bb420), whose reduction is pinned at blob 78e2f74f12382a39759b3dcb0c1d515d987ad836, and the monthly clock re-anchors to 2026-10-13 on THAT batch whatever this row returns.

WHY THIS ROW EXISTS. Today's cadenced row returned, for the first time in this project's history, a window in which the register's entries are followed by SECTION NAVIGATION rather than by another entry: '...Petaquilla Minerals Ltd. v. Republic of Panama (ICSID Case No. ARB/24/12) Decision on the Respondent’s Rule 41 Objection and Request for Security for Costs June 3, 2025 - In this section Overview Decisions on Manifest Lack of Legal Merit Decisions on Annulment Decisions on Disqual' (2026-10-13-daily reduction, records[1].excerpt, ok/200/text-html, 95,993 bytes, sha256 c3810fdaa1152bf8...). THE CHAIRMAN'S READING OF THAT IS THAT THE PETAQUILLA ENTRY IS THE REGISTER'S LAST IN DOCUMENT ORDER - which, if right, retires the right-edge-advance strategy this council's monthly row has used since August, because there is no unobserved register to its right. THAT IS A LOAD-BEARING STRUCTURAL CLAIM RESTING ON ONE LITERAL ON ONE BYTE STREAM, and this row tests it with a DIFFERENT literal on a SECOND, INDEPENDENT fetch. Firing it today rather than asserting the terminus on a single reading is the whole point.

THE LITERAL AND WHY IT IS THE RIGHT ONE. 'June 3, 2025 - In this section' spans the Petaquilla entry's DATE cell, its FOURTH COLUMN, and the TABLE/NAVIGATION BOUNDARY itself - a stronger boundary than any cell boundary, and one that no title, link label or 'recently added' panel can reproduce. It is carried character-for-character by the 2026-10-13-daily reduction quoted above (anchor-quote rule, 2026-09-24), and every hyphen in it is ASCII 0x2D, verified by codepoint against that excerpt rather than by eye - the same excerpt renders 'Respondent’s' with U+2019. FIRST FIRING: screened over all 614 rows in 80 analytics/fetch-results/*.json files at the time of writing, this literal has never been fired, and no literal containing 'In this section' has ever been fired on any host.

WHAT A TRUE FOUNDS: that on a second, independently-fetched byte stream the Petaquilla entry's fourth column is immediately followed by this page's section navigation in the tag-stripped stream - i.e. the register's entries terminate there in document order. WHAT IT STILL DOES NOT FOUND: that ICSID publishes nothing further anywhere on this surface, that the Petaquilla decision is the most recent (this register is NOT chronologically sorted - the tail runs May 29 2025, August 27 2026, February 6 2025, June 3 2025, so position carries NO time information), or anything whatever about any disposition, ground or holding. G16 bars a docket-summary surface from founding a disposition and G10 bars reading a document designation as a tribunal's characterisation. NO ROW CAN CLOSE THREAD 11, whose closure needs a primary document's BODY, and none can open its third 'gate fired / IP asserted / non-IP ground' bucket, which needs an indication that IP was asserted.

WHAT A FALSE WOULD MEAN, FIXED BEFORE THE ROW FIRES SO IT CANNOT BE READ CONVENIENTLY AFTERWARDS. A FALSE WOULD NOT RESTORE THE OLD STRATEGY AND WOULD NOT REFUTE THE TERMINUS. The find is exact as to form and case-insensitive only (scripts/fetch_relay.py:131), so a FALSE is consistent with (i) an entry having been APPENDED after Petaquilla between 11:20Z and this fetch, which is the single most interesting outcome available and is exactly what the proposed new anchor design is built to detect; (ii) the navigation prose re-rendering; or (iii) any change in the 168-byte-variable region this page is already measured to carry. ON A FALSE THE CHAIRMAN'S TERMINUS READING IS DOWNGRADED TO 'observed on one byte stream and not reproduced', the right-edge strategy is NOT re-booked, and the question goes to the next cadenced row - it is NOT re-fired today.

THE SAME-RUN CONTROL IS REQUIRED AND IS ROW 2. This row can legitimately null and excerpt_of returns the EMPTY STRING on a miss (:132-133), so a null hands back no window at all and would be indistinguishable from an instrument failure. Row 2 is 'Manifest Lack of Legal Merit', 12 fired / 12 TRUE on this exact URL across 2026-08-19 to 2026-10-13, every one ok/200 - it establishes that the origin answered and the tag-strip yielded prose from THIS byte stream. A FALSE ON ROW 2 VOIDS THE READING OF ROW 1 ENTIRELY. DIFF ON sha256, NEVER ON bytes: comparing this run's digest against c3810fdaa1152bf8 is what tells a page change apart from a find-form change, and equal byte length on this page is NOT evidence of unchanged content (96,161 bytes on three dates with three different digests).

OUTCOME CLASSES THAT ARE FACTS ABOUT THE INSTRUMENT AND MAY NEVER BE WRITTEN AS FINDINGS ABOUT ICSID OR ANY MATTER: control_ok false (whole batch VOID); refused / 403 / 202 / timeout / no_contact; host_not_allowed / scheme_not_https; a 404 or a redirect, which is NEVER a statement that the register does not exist. STANDING PROHIBITIONS HONOURED: no www.italaw.com or bare italaw.com row; no investmentpolicy.unctad.org or bare unctad.org row; no ARB/24/16 row; no dailyjus.com row; no IISD path-family row; no www.bing.com row; no pca-cpa.org row (the Servier/Poland forum row is ruled NOT EXECUTABLE today - no PCA locator for that caption exists in this repository and an index probe would be a discovery use the relay's own header forbids); no Ecuador-slug row; no Spentech synthesis row. TWO ROWS, one host (icsid.worldbank.org, ALLOWED_HOSTS at scripts/fetch_relay.py:48), well inside MAX_URLS = 12; the day's spend is now 5 of 12 and SEVEN SLOTS REMAIN FOR THE RESEARCH ANALYST. The control https://example.com/ is prepended by the relay itself and is not written below. LEXICOGRAPHIC ORDER: newest_request() is sorted(glob('*.json'))[-1], and '2026-10-13-zz-register-terminus.json' sorts above '2026-10-13-daily.json' because 'z' > 'd', so this batch is what the runner picks up; an analyst batch committed later today MUST be named to sort above this file or it will never run.
